options.text: Both only change tokenizer vocabulary
Quantization lowers numeric precision; distillation trains a smaller student to imitate a teacher
Quantization necessarily changes layer count, while distillation never trains parameters
Both guarantee zero accuracy loss

en-US.explanation: Quantization mainly changes numerical representation of weights/activations; distillation trains a student to absorb teacher behavior, often changing model capacity/architecture. They can be combined.

distractor_explanations.C: Quantization often preserves structure, while distillation explicitly trains a student.
distractor_explanations.D: Both can lose quality and require evaluation.
distractor_explanations.A: Neither technique is fundamentally a tokenizer-vocabulary change.

en-US.takeaway: Quantization changes numeric representation; distillation changes the model carrying the learned behavior.
